# Lab 10.10: Borderless Lakehouse Federation

## What We Are Going to Do
Federate an external Iceberg catalog (AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog or Snowflake Horizon) so BigQuery can query its tables in place. This is a Preview demo that needs an account on the other platform.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open the Lakehouse page.** In the console go to **Lakehouse → Catalogs → Create catalog → Federated catalog**.

2. **[Console] Choose the source.** Pick **AWS Glue** (or Databricks Unity Catalog / Snowflake Horizon). Enter the account details and the role or token the page asks for.

3. **[Console] Browse the namespaces.** After it connects, the external databases and tables appear under the catalog in BigQuery Explorer.

4. **[SQL] Query an external Iceberg table.**

6. **Discuss the trade-off.** Federation avoids copying data and keeps one source of truth, but each query pays cross-cloud egress and depends on the other platform being available.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Name | Borderless Lakehouse (formerly cross-cloud Lakehouse) |
| Sources | AWS Glue, Databricks Unity, Snowflake Horizon |
| Data | Stays where it is |
| Status | Preview, demo only |
